title: Feature document frontmatter
description: Frontmatter for a feature document in docs/feat/. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/feat.md section 2; this schema is its machine-checkable half. Change both in the same commit.

name.description: Kebab-case. Must match the filename minus .md, which the checker verifies separately.

allOf.$comment: The trigger clause naming the questions this document answers.

type.description: meta groups a feature area, feature documents a user-facing capability, component documents an internal building block. The type also selects a feat.<type>.structure.json layer.

status.description: Feature maturity. States where the feature stands today; never a version number.

components.description: Comma-separated, each entry prefixed module: (a module under src/lorewright/, snake_case and dotted), skill: (a directory under .agents/skills/, kebab-case), or spec: (a file stem under docs/__meta__/, kebab-case and dotted for a layer). The pattern fixes the prefix vocabulary and the character set; which separator each prefix uses is stated in feat.md section 2 and verified by reading, because one regular expression covering all three at once is less readable than the rule it encodes.
